The emitted-SQL test opens a new database on the same PostgreSQL cluster, where the canonical Supabase roles already exist. It previously attempted to create anon, authenticated and service_role unconditionally. The fixture now captures their original OIDs and nonsecret role attributes, digests configuration instead of exposing it, and records related membership and owning-database/schema/default ACL baselines. It creates only absent fixed roles inside the same transaction as the unchanged canonical emitted migration. The original service-role usage/DML/sequence and permanent-receipt select/insert-only assertions and client revocation checks are exact. The intentional rollback must restore every baseline descriptor, membership and relevant ACL, remove only fixture-created roles and leave no platform schema. It never drops or alters a preexisting role. A preexisting privileged client role still fails the original denial assertions; existence is not a privilege waiver.
